title: The cookie notice, one visitor: first visit, reject, the parent's cookie, the link, accept
description: The cookie notice (0.5.0, with the parent theme's contract), ONE visitor's journey on a page with the footer's «Configurar cookies» button: (1) first visit, no choice — consent-ready fires ONCE with null and the API set; Accept and Reject weigh the same (AEPD); «Powered by» visible, smaller, AA contrast MEASURED; ≥ 16 px between text and buttons at 402 and 1512 with Lavandería's :root :where(p) (played by consent-setup); the notice is the first thing when tabbing, Tab leaves it, Escape does not close it without a choice; the JS contract (categories, get, has, grant); (2) «Rechazar todas» stores the cookie in the PARENT's format and revision; the cookie the parent's notice wrote (≤ 0.6.0) is still valid; (3) the link reopens it with focus inside and Escape closes it once chosen; (4) open() + «Aceptar todas»: the event, the deferred script runs; on return the event fires on boot and open() shows the choices ticked. The events are recorded from the first instant by consent-events.js. Read by browser-consent-notice. It was consent-browser.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.

values.accept: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#estrategia-web-consent [data-estrategia-web-consent-action="accept"]'); const s = getComputedStyle(el); return [s.backgroundColor, s.color, s.fontSize, s.fontWeight, s.paddingTop, s.paddingLeft, s.borderTopWidth, el.offsetHeight].join('|'); })()
values.reject: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#estrategia-web-consent [data-estrategia-web-consent-action="reject"]'); const s = getComputedStyle(el); return [s.backgroundColor, s.color, s.fontSize, s.fontWeight, s.paddingTop, s.paddingLeft, s.borderTopWidth, el.offsetHeight].join('|'); })()
values.powered: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-consent__powered a'); if (!el) return null; let bg = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; for (let n = el; n; n = n.parentElement) { const c = getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor; if (!/rgba\(.*,\s*0\)$/.test(c) && c !== 'transparent') { bg = c; break; } } const s = getComputedStyle(el); const button = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-consent__button')); return { seen: __seen(el), rel: el.getAttribute('rel'), target: el.getAttribute('target'), color: s.color, bg, opacity: s.opacity, size: parseFloat(s.fontSize), buttonSize: parseFloat(button.fontSize) }; })()

values.gap: (() => { const text = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-consent__text'); const title = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-consent__title'); const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(text); const lastLine = Math.max(...[...range.getClientRects()].map((r) => r.bottom)); const button = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-consent__actions').getBoundingClientRect().top; return { gap: button - lastLine, titleGap: text.getBoundingClientRect().top - title.getBoundingClientRect().bottom }; })()

values.statistics: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('#estrategia-web-consent input[value="statistics"]'); return { checked: box.checked, label: box.closest('label').textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() }; })()
